diagnosis: Check C1 is passing in all rollouts despite the decision-maker having no access to the private facts PF1 or PF2. The model is simply defaulting to the baseline/standard values (8 hours, Tuesday standup, independent escalation) provided in the shared public facts S1 and S2, making C1 a trivial check that does not require the hidden information.
fix_instructions: Redesign check C1 so that it cannot be satisfied by the default values found in S1 and S2. It must specifically require a value that is only revealed by PF1 (e.g., checking for exactly 4 hours or a non-Tuesday standup day) or PF2 to ensure the check is structurally dependent on the hidden information.
